criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: Every beat maintains a single hero focal visual: botanical cards, extraction curve, casein micelle transformations, and steaming earthen kulhad cup. Header and takeaway tiers frame the central stage.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Clear tripartite type hierarchy using Playfair Display (22-40px titles), JetBrains Mono (19-20px data callouts/counters), and Inter (20px reading body). Zero text elements below the 19px readability floor.

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: True 9:16 vertical composition specifically authored with safe areas (top 128px, bottom 256px), central stage cards occupying >65% vertical real estate without dead void.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Multi-beat progression per scene: Scene 1 cracks spices progressively (0-15.3s), Scene 2 evolves boiling curve and counter (15.8-27.65s), Scene 3 complexates tannins (28.15-41.75s), Scene 4 double-rise and pour (42.25-54.25s) with 2.75s takeaway hold.

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: All text elements pass WCAG AA contrast against warm ivory (#FDFCF7) canvas using dark charcoal (#1F2937) and warm terracotta accents.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: Editorial-light culinary palette strictly observed: ivory parchment canvas, Assam amber (#78350F), chai terracotta (#B45309), cardamom emerald (#047857), and saffron accents (#FCD34D).

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Explicit narrative transitions: Push transition moves from raw spices to boiling water; wipe reveals milk emulsion; circular mask opens into authentic pouring and finish. Element continuity preserved.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Unified visual language with card containers, rounded pill tags, live counter rolls, smooth Catmull-Rom spline curves, and virtual camera drift.

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: All movement maps to thermodynamic extraction: spice fracture triggers radial oil release, saucepan heating drives boiling bubble convection, and tannin spikes transform into encapsulated shields.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: Strict adherence to Anti-Laziness Mandate: visual states evolve every 2-3 seconds during speech. Continuous camera drift prevents frozen screen perception.

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: Zero layout faults across all timeline samples. Content stays strictly within top (128px) and bottom (256px) Instagram Reels safe zones.

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: Complete four-act culinary arc: raw spice physics -> boiling water decoction -> milk casein binding -> double rise and earthen kulhad finish. The takeaway holds cleanly for 2.75s to 57.0s.

pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
